description: Compress equal aggregate values over contiguous subarray-start ranges for every right endpoint.

source.title: Distinct Subarray Aggregates
source.algorithm_attribution: Each new value is folded into the previous suffix aggregates; adjacent equal values merge their start-index ranges.
source.implementation_status: clean-room bounded scalar profile; algorithm description only

components.aggregate_sum: Sum of the selected aggregate over every nonempty subarray.
components.suffix_distinct_count: Sum, over right endpoints, of the number of distinct aggregate values among suffixes ending there.

workspace.meaning: Fixed arrays for at most 65 aggregate segments and their inclusive start-index intervals.

contract.algorithm: Maintain the distinct aggregates of suffixes ending at the newest value as contiguous start-index ranges; fold in the value and merge adjacent equal ranges.
contract.secondary_bound: Each endpoint has at most 9 distinct suffix aggregates: OR/AND can change at most once per bit after the initial value; GCD has at most one zero followed by a strictly decreasing positive divisor chain. Thus the total is at most 9*64=576, below packing multiplier 1024.
contract.invalid_frames: Reject null input, modes outside 0..2, lengths outside 0..64, values outside 0..255, and malformed or trailing words.

complexity.primary_time: O(N*S), where S<=9 is the number of distinct suffix aggregates at one endpoint

oracle_method: The primary keeps compressed contiguous ranges of starting indices for equal suffix aggregates. The independent oracle folds every subarray directly and counts distinct aggregate values for each right endpoint with a set.
